en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view over a small European town with dense low-rise houses, trees, and fields in the distance. A church with a tall tower and onion-shaped spire stands prominently to the right. The sky is cloudy, and the image has a white border with a deckled edge typical of vintage postcards. At the bottom left, printed text identifies the scene as a view from the old water tower in Elsterwerda.
